mapper.select: SELECT product_name, remark_number, MAX(code_number) AS code_number, MAX(specification) AS specification, SUM(in_quantity) AS in_quantity, SUM(out_quantity) AS out_quantity, (IFNULL(SUM(in_quantity), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(out_quantity), 0)) AS current_stock, MAX(price) AS price FROM stockinout_data WHERE product_remark_checked = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND remark_number IS NOT NULL AND remark_number <> '' GROUP BY product_name, remark_number HAVING current_stock > 0 ORDER BY product_name, remark_number
